title: I made a cozy alchemist’s castle PC game : PotionsTidy
author: fireweb2
selftext:
Hello,

I've been working on my indie game, PotionsTidy.

Clean up, organize your space in this cozy and relaxing game. Pick up potions and objetcs scattered across the floor and freely place them wherever you want across 300 different placement surfaces. With over 3,000 objects, no grid, and no time limits.

**Available from today on Steam Platform** (whishlist only)

Claude Code AI was used to help me with certain tasks, such as implementing the save system, menus, and scoring system.

The entire project was developed in Unreal Engine 5.8, using C++ along with a few Blueprints made by me.

Here is a video showing the early beginnings of the game and how the project started [https://youtu.be/MOiXt7zg9Ww](https://youtu.be/MOiXt7zg9Ww)

  
I'd really love to hear your feedback

Thanks for checking out PotionsTidy !
